label: 竜の街

light.mood: a warm late afternoon with long shadows

style.outdoor: Painterly high-detail fantasy concept art, warm late-afternoon golden sunlight, soft shadows, rich saturated colors, clean and readable, game environment art quality.
style.indoor: Painterly high-detail fantasy concept art, warm interior lantern and firelight, cosy shadowed corners, rich saturated colors, game environment art quality.

continuity: exactly ONE light in the sky, the sun stated below. Every shadow in the picture falls directly away from it.
the river runs along the SOUTH side of the valley and the wooded ridge rises on the NORTH. They never appear in the same direction.
the river is crossed by exactly ONE bridge, a single-span arched bridge of pale grey stone. There is no ford and no second crossing.
the plaza holds exactly ONE fountain, a carved grey stone dragon spouting into a round basin, and it is the only fountain in the town.
every roof in the town is dark blue-grey slate at the same steep pitch.
